statements.t: (Surrozen or the Company) (Nasdaq: SRZN), a biotechnology company pioneering targeted therapeutics to harness the power of Wnt signaling to address the underlying drivers of disease in sight-threatening ophthalmic conditions, today announced the closing of the second and final tranche of its March 2025 private placement of securities.

"With expected cash runway into 2029, we are well positioned to advance SZN-8141 into the DUET Phase 1b/2a study and initiate clinical development of SZN-8143, while maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation."
